title: Why tofu and soy sauce Works So Well Together
flavorProfile: The pairing offers a deep savory umami from soy sauce complemented by the mild, slightly sweet, creamy character of tofu, creating a balanced sweet‑savory‑umami profile.
nutritionalSynergy: Soy sauce contains amino acids and small peptides that can chelate iron and calcium, enhancing their absorption when consumed with tofu, which is rich in these minerals; additionally, the sodium may increase the bioavailability of certain B vitamins.
prepTechniques: Press the tofu block with paper towels or a tofu press to remove excess water.
Cut the tofu into 1‑inch cubes and optionally coat with a thin layer of cornstarch.
Heat a skillet, add a splash of soy sauce, then sauté the tofu until golden, allowing the sauce to caramelize.

faq.a: Transfer leftovers to an airtight container and refrigerate for up to 3 days. For longer storage, freeze in a freezer‑safe bag for up to 2 months.
You can replace tofu with tempeh or seitan for a different texture, and soy sauce can be swapped with tamari, coconut aminos, or a mixture of miso paste and water, though the flavor will vary.
